gizmo.title: Ihe ọkpụkpọ akwụkwọ ntụziaka
gizmo.description: Ntụziaka, ngosi na ntụaka maka web component, nwere bọtịnụ idetuo maka HTML, import, npm na CDN.

configure.title: Faịlụ data akwụkwọ ntụziaka
configure.description: Data akwụkwọ ntụziaka na-abịa na ihe ahụ (lib/tag.docs.json).

configure.title: Storyboard ntụziaka
configure.description: Storyboard mmegharị na-abịa na ihe ahụ (tag.motion.json). Nhọrọ.

configure.title: Vidiyo nkuzi
configure.description: Vidiyo dị mkpụmkpụ banyere ihe ahụ (YouTube, Vimeo ma ọ bụ faịlụ vidiyo). Ọ na-anọchi vidiyo dị na data akwụkwọ ntụziaka.

configure.title: Kpọọ ntụziaka na-akpaghị aka
configure.description: Malite ntụziaka ozugbo ihe ọkpụkpọ ahụ pụtara. A na-eleghara ya anya mgbe onye na-agụ akwụkwọ họọrọ mmegharị belatara.

advanced.title: Isiokwu ntụziaka
advanced.description: Maka ihe nwere ọtụtụ ntụziaka, isiokwu nke a ga-ebu ụzọ meghee (dịka add-blocks). Hapụ ya efu maka nke isi.

advanced.title: Njikọ ngosi ndụ
advanced.description: Ebe bọtịnụ Mepee isi ngosi na-aga. Ndabara ya bụ folda demo dị n'ebe nchekwa.

advanced.title: Njikọ akwụkwọ ntụziaka
advanced.description: Ebe bọtịnụ akwụkwọ ntụziaka zuru ezu na-aga, dịka peeji Learn HAX kwekọrọ.
